work.title: Cantate til Universitetets Fest i Anledning af Kronprinds Frederiks og Kronprindsesse Lovisas Formæling d. 28. Juli 1869
Cantata on the Occasion of Crown Prince Frederik's and Crown Princess Lovisa's Wedding on 28 July 1869
Hil Dig!
Formælings-Cantaten

event.desc: Concert in honour of Hartmann's 50th anniversary as chairman of Studenter-Sangforeningen.

history.p: Crown Prince Frederik, the later King Frederik VIII (1843-1912), had married the Swedish princess Lovisa Josefina Eugenia of Sweden-Norway (1851-1926) in Stockholm on 28 July 1869; the festivities at the University, however, did not take place until 5 October that year.

bibl.title: Studenter-Sangforeningen 1839 1889. Nogle Mindeblade samlede af Axel Sørensen

termList.term: Music for vocal soloists and instruments with or without choir

incipText.p: Hil Dig! Hil Dig, Hil Dig!
De Unge talte, de Unge sang
Hør hvor det dundrer fra Mælarens Vande
Velsignet være den Dag, da du kom hid
Atter Himlen er skyfuld [originally "Unge Kræfter behøves"]
Hil dig! Hil dig, Hil dig!

physDesc.physMedium: In a paper folder. On the front cover in foreign hand: "Qvæsthusgade 3 2 Sal". In Hartmann's hand in brown ink: "Skizze til Formælings - Cantaten" and in blue crayon: "Op 69 27/9 69". Paper: 16 staves. Manuscript written on eight bifolios of which the first seven are written in brown ink on 2-4 staves with minor corrections in ink, pencil and blue crayon, whereas the last bifolio is written in pencil.

physLoc.identifier: C II, 7 Hartmanns Samling 152 (Kapsel F - G)

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in marbled cardboard with label in Hartmann's hand: " Cantate / til / Universitetets Fest i Anled- / ning af Kronprinds Frederiks / og Kronprindsesse Lovisas / Formæling d. 28 Juli 1869. / Partitur." Written in brown ink. Paper: 20 staves. On p. 1 in upper right-hand corner in pencil : "A III - H 2 - P. 1." Beneath in Hartmann's hand in brown ink: "opført første Gang ved Universitetsfesten 8 Novbr. 1869 / opført anden Gg. ved Studentersangfor- / eningens Concert i Casino 2 Decbr 69". In purple ink: "3die Gang ved Sangforeningens Concert i / Concertpalæets store Sal 2 Mai 1893." Page 60 blank. Between pp. 74 and 75 a folio has been inserted, the first page has been cancelled, on the verso in pencil in Hartmann's hand: "Til No 7 i [?] den foregaaende Duet udelades", and one bar for the strings, which has also been crossed out. The first four pages of No. 8 in foreign hand. Added in upper right-hand corner in Hartmann's hand: "/: Instrumentation, som / til Choret N o 1/.
Written in brown ink. Paper: 12 staves. Above No. 3 only the reference: " Se, "Album for Sang". NB den første trykte Takt udgaaer." No. 8 erroneously called "No. 9."
